core_obligations: Derive smoothness at the prime from formal smoothness by the Artinian test (proof lines 9667-9668).
From smoothness at the prime, pass to a localisation on which the map is smooth (proof lines 9669-9671).
Use formal smoothness of smooth maps and its preservation under localisation, with the cotangent complex justification, to reach the localisations (proof lines 9672-9680).
Apply the comparison lemma to obtain formal smoothness in the adic topology (proof lines 9681-9684).
proof_roadmap: From formal smoothness to smoothness (proof lines 9667-9668).
Preservation under localisation and upgrade to the adic topology (proof lines 9672-9684).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies smoothness of a finite type algebra over a Noetherian ring at a prime with formal smoothness of the corresponding localisation in the adic topology. One implication is quoted from the Artinian test criterion for smoothness. For the other, smoothness at the prime spreads to a localisation of the algebra, which is formally smooth by the statement that smooth algebras are formally smooth; localisation preserves formal smoothness, which the author justifies through the characterisation by the cotangent complex and its behaviour under localisation, and finally the passage from algebraic formal smoothness to the adic topology is supplied by the comparison lemma.
